phase_2.title: Phase 2 · Peak Tension & Mechanical Anchor
phase_2.description: At full draw, high-tension recurve limbs discharge stored elastic energy down the machined rail upon trigger break, holding the 18" 400 gr Carbon Crossbow Bolt projectile aligned on the launch datum.

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Elastic Limb Recovery & Acceleration

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Rest Clearance & Fletching Spin

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Brace-Height Stop & Vibration Decay

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Safety Engagement & Next-Shot Prep
phase_7.description: The release assembly resets automatically, preparing the Excalibur for the next precision launch out to 100 m.

zh.headline: 神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩：2022 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 神剑 Assassin Extreme 摒弃一切复杂偏心滑轮与辅助缆绳，凭借高模量反曲复合弩片与内置静音曲柄棘轮机构输出 400 fps 箭速，可在野外免专用弓床直接徒手换弦。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Excalibur 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2022 年问世的 神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩 由加拿大神剑弩业（Excalibur Crossbow）主导研制，定位为经典的反曲机械曲柄重弩。加拿大神剑公司坚持反曲弩路线逾四十年，通过极限压缩反曲弩片前倾角使传统反曲结构突破了 400 fps 现代超高速门槛。
神剑 Assassin Extreme 摒弃一切复杂偏心滑轮与辅助缆绳，凭借高模量反曲复合弩片与内置静音曲柄棘轮机构输出 400 fps 箭速，可在野外免专用弓床直接徒手换弦。 整件装备总长 813 mm（32 in 总长）、空重 3.36 kg，成为同期冷兵弓弩领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2022 年，加拿大神剑弩业（Excalibur Crossbow）推出了划时代的神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩。加拿大神剑公司坚持反曲弩路线逾四十年，通过极限压缩反曲弩片前倾角使传统反曲结构突破了 400 fps 现代超高速门槛。 它的核心设计聚焦于零凸轮、零副缆纯反曲几何，极端寒湿环境机械可靠性极高，奠定了其在冷兵弓弩发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: CNC 铝合金箭道主机匣

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩 的机械灵魂在于其「纯反曲玻纤高张力弩片 · 集成静音棘轮上弦曲柄」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，反曲高张力弩片在扳机释放瞬间沿箭道爆发弹性势能加速碳纤弩箭，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。内置 Charger 静音曲柄将 290 lbf 拉力降为约 12 lbf 省力摇动，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩 采用纯反曲玻纤高张力弩片 · 集成静音棘轮上弦曲柄。在每个击发周期中，反曲高张力弩片在扳机释放瞬间沿箭道爆发弹性势能加速碳纤弩箭。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了内置 Charger 静音曲柄将 290 lbf 拉力降为约 12 lbf 省力摇动。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主弓弦与同步分弦缆绳

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 18" 400 gr Carbon Crossbow Bolt 弹药规格与 381 mm 驱动行程（15 in Power Stroke · 290 lbf 拉力），最高工作膛压约 0.9 MPa，可赋予弹头 122 m/s 的出膛初速与 193 J 动能，有效作用距离达 100 米。
内膛技术特点方面，CNC 铝合金阳极氧化箭道配合防空放棘爪与两段式精密扳机。同时，Pro-Shot 竞赛级两段式扳机搭配 CeaseFire 防空放保险机构，令其在 4 箭/分（曲柄棘轮上弦） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 381 毫米身管与 18" 400 gr Carbon Crossbow Bolt 口径，神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩 实现了每秒 122 米的初速与 100 米有效射程。CNC 铝合金阳极氧化箭道配合防空放棘爪与两段式精密扳机，展现了卓越的工程平衡。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高储能复合/反曲弹性弓片组

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 4 发容量的箭壶本体与碳纤箭矢组与 42 mm 膛轴设计，神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩 将单发后坐冲量控制在 3.2 N·s 水平。Tru-Fit 可调伸缩托与贴腮板配合分体式消音阻弦器。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-92）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 4 发容量的箭壶本体与碳纤箭矢组与出色的整体工效，Tru-Fit 可调伸缩托与贴腮板配合分体式消音阻弦器。欢迎在 BAY-92 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 神剑 Assassin Extreme 高能反曲弩 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Excalibur Assassin Extreme: The 2022 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Eliminating cams and auxiliary cables entirely, the Excalibur Assassin Extreme drives 400-grain bolts to 400 fps using ultra-durable high-output recurve limbs and an integrated silent ratchet crank, allowing tool-free field string changes. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-92.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Excalibur
paragraphs: Introduced in 2022 by Excalibur Crossbow in Canada, the Excalibur Assassin Extreme emerged as a defining High-Energy Recurve Crossbow. For over four decades Excalibur championed camless recurve crossbows, proving through steep high-modulus limb angles that traditional recurve geometry could surpass the 400 fps barrier.

Eliminating cams and auxiliary cables entirely, the Excalibur Assassin Extreme drives 400-grain bolts to 400 fps using ultra-durable high-output recurve limbs and an integrated silent ratchet crank, allowing tool-free field string changes. Measuring 813 mm (32 in Overall Length) at an unloaded weight of 3.36 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Archery & Crossbow class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2022, Excalibur Crossbow of Canada introduced the Excalibur Assassin Extreme. For over four decades Excalibur championed camless recurve crossbows, proving through steep high-modulus limb angles that traditional recurve geometry could surpass the 400 fps barrier. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Zero-cam, zero-cable pure recurve limb geometry maximizes field reliability — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Excalibur Assassin Extreme sits its Pure High-Tension Recurve Limbs · Integrated Silent Charger Ratchet Crank. Throughout every firing cycle, high-tension recurve limbs discharge stored elastic energy down the machined rail upon trigger break, containing 0.9 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Integrated Charger crank reduces 290 lbf draw load to ~12 lbf cranking effort, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Excalibur Assassin Extreme relies on Pure High-Tension Recurve Limbs · Integrated Silent Charger Ratchet Crank. During each cycle, high-tension recurve limbs discharge stored elastic energy down the machined rail upon trigger break. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Integrated Charger crank reduces 290 lbf draw load to ~12 lbf cranking effort.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 18" 400 gr Carbon Crossbow Bolt with 381 mm Power Stroke (15 in · 290 lbf Draw Weight), the Excalibur Assassin Extreme develops 122 m/s muzzle velocity and 193 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 100 meters.

Internally, CNC anodized aluminum flight rail with anti-dry-fire latch and two-stage match trigger. Combined with its 4 bolts/min (integrated crank) tempo, Pro-Shot two-stage match trigger paired with CeaseFire anti-dry-fire interlock, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 18" 400 gr Carbon Crossbow Bolt through its 381 millimeter bore, the Excalibur Assassin Extreme achieves 122 meters per second and 100 meters of effective reach. CNC anodized aluminum flight rail with anti-dry-fire latch and two-stage match trigger.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 4-round quiver body & arrow assembly with a 42 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 3.2 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Adjustable stock and cheekpiece with rubberized string suppressors.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-92), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 4-round quiver body & arrow assembly with disciplined recoil geometry, Adjustable stock and cheekpiece with rubberized string suppressors. Explore BAY-92 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Excalibur Assassin Extreme.
